entities.name: Gözde Yılmaz

entities.summary: Gözde Yılmaz is a Turkish volleyball player. She is 195 cm (6.40 ft) tall at 82 kg (181 lb). Currently, she plays for Eczacıbaşı VitrA. Yılmaz is a member of the Turkey women's national volleyball team.
